description: South Korean pharmacies registered as open on a given Sunday or Korean public holiday, by province and district, with self-reported opening hours, phone number, road address and a WIA Gil map link. Data: National Medical Center registry via data.go.kr, refreshed weekly. Lists only, with no information about medicines. Every response carries a notice that hours are self-reported and should be confirmed by phone before visiting. Without region: counts per province; with a province: counts per district; with province/district: the pharmacy list.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a Sunday or a Korean public holiday (default: the next one, Seoul time).

lang.description: ko (default) or any other code for romanized place names.

region.description: Province slug (seoul) or province/district (seoul/gangseo); Korean names also work (서울, 서울 강서구). Omit for nationwide counts.

name: open_pharmacies
title: Pharmacies open on Sundays and Korean public holidays
